The Santoku Knife is a Japanese variant of the chef's knife. The Santoku, which translates to "three ways," is a flexible knife that can be used for slicing, dicing, and mincing, among other things. This small 13cm Santoku Knife, which easily slices through vegetables, fruit, and meat, was originally crafted and invented for Japanese homemakers who wanted to recreate Western-style cuisine in their kitchen (not to be confused with the other Western-style Japanese knife - Gyoto).
Since Japanese chefs usually used forward and backward cutting strokes or a straight up and down slice, the Santoku knife's blade had no curve. This meant that the rocking motion on a cutting board could not be accomplished. The Santoku knife, which was relatively unknown ten years ago, has grown tremendously in popularity over the last few years.

Description: RF Greenworks 3 Cutting Boards 37x28cm Red Black White
Intro:
In an era where environmental consciousness takes centre stage, at Grunwerg we are committed to addressing our own carbon footprint and actively participating in industry-wide efforts to mitigate climate change and combat the global climate crisis.
Greenworks represents our commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. By using only fully recycled plastic in our products and eliminating single-use plastic and unnecessary paper from packaging, we are taking crucial steps toward a greener future. At Grunwerg, we recognize the importance of environmental consciousness, especially in today’s world where protecting the planet is more critical than ever. We are dedicated to reducing our carbon footprint and playing an active role in industry-wide initiatives to combat climate change. Our eco-friendly approach ensures that every product not only meets high-quality standards but also contributes to a sustainable future. Through these efforts, Greenworks is helping lead the way toward a more environmentally conscious world, where every small change counts. Boards come in a set of three pieces with different colours for different types of food. The boards have a Thumb grip hole for easy manoeuverability and grip. Additionally there is a liquid recess around the whole board to help drain liquids from any type of food and having the grip whole allows quick and easy ability to pour off any excess liquids.
• FULLY RECYCLABLE
• MADE FROM 50% RECYCLED PP
• DISHWASHER SAFE
• BPA FREE
• PLASTIC FREE PACKAGING
• HEAT RESISTANT UP TO 120°C
• SET OF 3 COLOURS - RED, WHITE & BLACK

A new dawn for knife maintenance. 
Rockingham Forge introduce their roller sharpener to revolutionise the way in which you can keep your knives sharp to deliver optimum performance. 
This two-piece kit is simple to use and requires no prior knowledge or skill. Simply attach your knife to the magnetic base and roll the sharpener along the length of the blade to return the sharp edge.
The stand serves as a magnetic base that holds your knife at a given angle. Each of the four sides represent a different sharpening angle. 
15 degrees is the correct angle for all Rockingham Forge knives.
18 degrees is suited to other Japanese knives, especially Santoku Knives.
20 degrees is suitable for most kitchen knives of European origin.
25 degrees can be used for Chinese chopping knives, butcher's cleaver and outdoor hunting knives.
The roller sharpener has a silent rolling design and a strong, stable magnetic base. With just a light back and forth motion anyone can sharpen their kitchen knives like an expert. The sharpener discs can be easily changed, and all can be used without the addition of water, keeping sharpening fast and convenient. 
The Rockingham Forge Roller Sharpener is made of aluminium alloy, which is sturdy and durable. The precision-machined aluminium alloy drum and silently designed roller ensure a smooth knife sharpening experience and keep knife sharpening angle consistent.
The roller sharpener is equipped with 4 grinding discs, diamond 360grit, diamond 600grit, whetstone 1000grit and ceramic 3000grit. 
The diamond discs are industrial grade, these sharpen all hardness steels and are suitable for very dull and damaged edge blades.
The 1000grit whetstone disc is most useful for daily sharpening and maintenance.
Finally, the 3000grit ceramic disc is suitable for finishing and honing your blade to an ultra-fine edge.
